items.body_zh: 上周五纳指收跌近3%，英特尔暴跌超28%，苹果市值超英伟达；黄金重挫创一年新低；原油连涨四个月。 上证报：中国金融管理部门11月2日将开会研究推动支持资本市场工具使用。 中国证监会：全力稳市场稳预期，深化投融资综合改革，完善全链条监管体系，持续提升资本市场韧性和信心。 中国10月官方制造业PMI 49.3，非制造业PMI 49.7，均较9月有所回落。
items.title_en: Breakfast on Wall Street | November 2, 2026.
items.body_en: On Friday, the index closed down nearly 3%, Intel plunged more than 28%, Apple's market value exceeded Nvidia; gold hit a new low for a year; crude oil rose for four consecutive months. Shanghai Report: China's financial regulatory authorities will meet on November 2 to study and promote the use of capital market tools. China's the CSRC: make every effort to stabilize market expectations, deepen the comprehensive reform of investment and financing, improve the chain-wide supervision system, and continuously improve the resilience and confidence of the capital market. China's official manufacturing PMI in October was 49.3, and non-manufacturing PMI was 49.7, both down from September.

items.title_zh: 奥精医疗：涉嫌定期报告等财务数据虚假记载 证监会决定对公司立案
items.body_zh: 奥精医疗公告，公司于2026年11月1日收到中国证监会对公司下发的《立案告知书》。因公司涉嫌定期报告等财务数据虚假记载，中国证监会决定对公司立案。若后续经中国证监会行政处罚认定的事实，触及规定的重大违法强制退市情形，公司股票将被实施重大违法强制退市。敬请投资者注意投资风险。目前公司各项经营管理、业务及财务状况正常。
items.title_en: Aojing Medical: Suspected of falsely recording financial data such as periodic reports, the CSRC decided to file a case against the company.
items.body_en: Aojing Medical Announcement, the company received the "Case Filing Notice" issued by the CSRC of China on November 1, 2026. The CSRC in China decided to file a case against the company because the company is suspected of misrepresenting financial data such as periodic reports. If the facts subsequently determined by the CSRC administrative penalty in China are found to have touched on the stipulated circumstances of mandatory delisting for major violations, the company's shares will be delisted for major violations. Investors are advised to be aware of investment risks. At present, the company's various business management, business and financial conditions are normal.

items.title_zh: 金融管理部门将召开会议 研究推动支持资本市场工具使用
items.body_zh: 从业内获悉，金融管理部门11月2日将召开会议。有证券公司、基金公司接到通知，11月2日中国人民银行、中国证监会召开会议，研究推动支持资本市场工具使用。同一天，中国人民银行、金融监管总局、中国证监会还将召集各大银行开会研究优化股票回购增持再贷款政策。
items.title_en: The Financial Regulatory Authority will convene a conference to study and promote the use of capital market instruments.
items.body_en: According to industry sources, the financial regulator will hold a meeting on November 2. Securities companies and fund companies were informed that the People's Bank of China and the CSRC of China held a meeting on November 2 to study and promote the use of capital market support tools. On the same day, the People's Bank of China, the State Administration of Financial Supervision and the CSRC of China will also convene a meeting of major banks to study and optimize the share buyback re-lending policy.

items.title_zh: 沪市公司10月已实施回购超326亿元，分红、增持同步发力
items.body_zh: 10月以来，面对市场调整，沪市上市公司通过回购、增持及分红等方式传递市场信心。10月，714家沪市公司累计披露增持回购及各类利好公告1019份，其中新增增持回购98家次，金额合计上限165.07亿元。
items.title_en: The Shanghai company has implemented share buyback of over 32.6 billion yuan in October, dividends, increase holdings and synchronize efforts.
items.body_en: Since October, in the face of market adjustment, Shanghai listed companies have passed on market confidence through share buyback, overweight and dividend. In October, 714 Shanghai listed companies disclosed 1019 share buyback and various positive announcements, of which 98 share buybacks were added, with a total upper limit of 16.507 billion yuan.

items.title_zh: 国有某大行计划向中国国新和中国诚通各新增千亿级股票回购增持专项贷款额度
items.body_zh: 记者今日从相关渠道了解到，一家国有超大型银行近日计划向中国国新、中国诚通两家央企新增股票回购增持贷款额度，单家新增额度或可达到1000亿元。据悉，此次新增的再贷款额度规模，或将超过2024年该政策工具设立时该行向上述主体发放的首期额度。（证券时报）
items.title_en: A major state-owned bank plans to increase its special loan quota to China New and China Chengtong by 100 billion shares each share buyback.
items.body_en: The reporter learned today from relevant channels that a state-owned super-large bank recently plans to increase the share buyback loan quota of China Guoxin and China Chengtong two central enterprises, and the single new quota may reach 100 billion yuan. It is reported that the size of the new refinancing quota may exceed the initial quota issued by the bank to the above-mentioned entities when the policy tool is established in 2024. (Securities Times).

items.title_zh: 央行、证监会将于明天召开座谈会 研究推动支持资本市场工具使用
items.body_zh: 一些证券公司和基金公司接到通知，明天上午央行、证监会召开会议，研究推动支持资本市场工具使用。 (21世纪经济报道)
items.title_en: the PBOC, the CSRC will hold a symposium tomorrow to research and promote support for the use of capital market tools.
items.body_en: Some securities firms and fund companies have been notified that tomorrow morning the PBOC, the CSRC will meet to examine ways to promote the use of capital market instruments. (21st Century Business Report).

items.title_zh: 美国农民不满 共和党票仓“摇摆”
items.body_zh: 美国广大农业区长期被视为共和党的选举基本盘，也是美国总统特朗普两次当选的重要票仓。但随着11月3日中期选举临近，有民调显示，共和党候选人在多个长期占据优势的农业州选情告急。分析人士认为，现任政府对伊朗发动军事行动推高能源和化肥价格，其关税政策又直接波及农产品出口，这都导致美国农民利益受损，进而影响共和党选情。
items.title_en: US farmers unhappy with Republican ticket swing.
items.body_en: The vast agricultural area of the United States has long been regarded as the electoral base of the Republican Party, and it is also an important ballot box for President Trump to be elected twice. But as the Nov. 3 midterm elections draw near, polls show Republican candidates in a number of agrarian states that have long held sway. Analysts believe that the current administration's military action against Iran has pushed up energy and fertilizer prices, and its tariff policy has directly affected agricultural exports, which has damaged the interests of American farmers and thus affected the Republican Party's election.

items.title_zh: 整点回顾
items.body_zh: 沪指早间高开震荡，创业板指回落翻绿，白酒、券商、游戏、食品等方向领涨，贵金属、机器人、军工、油气等板块下挫，个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市约3000股飘绿，开盘半小时成交5820亿，较上日此时放量超100亿。
items.title_en: The Whole Point Review.
items.body_en: Shanghai index opened high and shook in the morning, the gem index fell back and turned green, liquor, brokerage, games, food and other directions led the rise, precious metals, robots, military, oil and gas and other sectors fell, individual stocks fell more, rose less, Shanghai and Shenzhen three cities about 3,000 shares green, opening half an hour 582 billion transactions, compared with the previous day at this time more than 10 billion.

items.title_zh: 铠侠控股股价大跌 业绩展望谨慎令投资者失望
items.body_zh: 铠侠控股股价周一一度大跌15%，这家日本存储芯片制造商谨慎的业绩展望令投资者失望，加剧外界对人工智能（AI）驱动的爆炸性增长可能正趋于平缓的担忧。
items.title_en: Cautious outlook for Kioxia Holdings' plummeting share price disappoints investors.
items.body_en: Kioxia Holdings plunged 15% on Monday as the cautious outlook for the Japanese memory chipmaker disappointed investors and heightened fears that the explosive growth driven by artificial intelligence (AI) could be leveling off.

items.title_zh: 中信建投：中期底部形成往往较为波折 保持耐心
items.body_zh: 中信建投指出，近期市场继续处于9月底以来的第二轮去杠杆过程中，本周A股由此前单边下跌转为高波动震荡，当前市场压力主要来自三个方面：一是中东地缘局势反复油价高位，叠加法国等经济体局部债务风险及美联储后续加息预期，海外流动性偏紧；二是海外三季报好坏参半；三是国内流动性压力尚未完全消化，绝对收益资金的减仓担忧仍在。积极信号在于，10月以来稳市资金已陆续入场。
items.title_en: CITIC: The formation of the bottom in the medium term tends to be more volatile and patient.
items.body_en: CITIC pointed out that the recent market continued to be in the second round of deleveraging since the end of September. This week, A-shares have turned from a unilateral decline to a high volatility and volatility. The current market pressure mainly comes from three aspects: first, the geographical situation in the Middle East has repeatedly been high in oil prices, coupled with the local debt risks of France and other economies and the Federal Reserve's subsequent interest rate hike expectations, and overseas liquidity is tight; second, overseas three-quarter reports are mixed; third, domestic liquidity pressures have not been fully digested, and concerns about the reduction of absolute income funds remain. The positive sign is that since October, stable market funds have been entering the market one after another.

items.title_zh: 香港证监会称欢迎香港交易所扩大中国国债作为保证金抵押品的适用范围
items.body_zh: 香港证监会称，欢迎香港交易所扩大中国国债作为保证金抵押品的适用范围。香港交易所今天扩大中国国债及中国政策性银行债作为合资格非现金保证金抵押品的适用范围至旗下的上市衍生工具结算所。有关结算所已将非现金保证金抵押品的融通费用下调至年率0.15%。这些优化措施有助降低市场参与者的融资成本，并促进本港固定收益及货币市场生态系统的持续发展。
items.title_en: The CSRC in Hong Kong said it welcomed the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's expansion of the scope of application of Chinese government bonds as collateral for margin deposits.
items.body_en: The CSRC in Hong Kong said it welcomed the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's expansion of the scope of application of Chinese government bonds as collateral for margin. The Hong Kong Stock Exchange today extended the application of China Treasury Bonds and China Policy Bank Bonds as collateral for eligible non-cash margin to its listed derivatives clearing houses. The clearing house has reduced the financing fee for non-cash margin collateral to an annual rate of 0.15%. These optimizations help to reduce financing costs for market participants and contribute to the continued development of Hong Kong's fixed income and money market ecosystems.

items.body_zh: 周五（10月30日）纽约尾盘，现货黄金跌3.65%，报3874.76美元/盎司，10月份累跌6.80%。 COMEX黄金期货累跌7.05%，报3884.90美元/盎司。 现货白银跌5.83%，报49.1077美元/盎司，10月份累跌18.73%。 COMEX白银期货累跌19%，报49.135美元/盎司。 COMEX铜期货跌1.41%，报6.5095美元/磅，10月份累跌约1.83%。
items.title_en: Spot Gold fell 3.65% to $3874.76/ounce at the end of New York on Friday (October 30).
items.body_en: Spot gold closed Friday (October 30) in New York down 3.65% at $3874.76/oz, down 6.80% in October. COMEX gold futures were down 7.05% at $3884.90/oz. spot silver was down 5.83% at $49.1077/oz, down 18.73% in October. Comex silver futures fell 19% to $49.135/oz. COMEX copper futures fell 1.41% to $6.5095/lb, down about 1.83% in October.

items.title_zh: 国家统计局：10月高技术制造业和装备制造业PMI分别为51.3%和50.6%
items.body_zh: 国家统计局称，10月份，受“十一”假期前部分需求提前释放以及国际环境复杂多变等因素影响，制造业PMI降至49.3%。新动能保持较快增长。高技术制造业和装备制造业PMI分别为51.3%和50.6%，继续高于临界点，相关行业企业生产经营保持扩张，新质生产力延续良好发展态势。消费品行业和高耗能行业PMI分别为48.8%和47.3%，比上月下降1.9个和0.7个百分点，市场活跃度有所减弱。
items.title_en: the National Bureau of Statistics: High-tech manufacturing and equipment manufacturing PMIs in October were 51.3% and 50.6%, respectively.
items.body_en: the National Bureau of Statistics said that in October, the manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3% due to factors such as the early release of some demand before the 11/11 holiday and the complex and volatile international environment. New momentum keeps growing faster. The PMIs of the high-tech manufacturing industry and the equipment manufacturing industry were 51.3% and 50.6%, respectively, which continued to be higher than the critical point. The production and operation of enterprises in related industries maintained expansion, and the new quality productivity continued to develop well. The PMIs of the consumer goods industry and the energy-intensive industry were 48.8% and 47.3%, respectively, down 1.9 percentage points and 0.7 percentage points from the previous month, and market activity weakened.

items.title_zh: 伊朗外长阿拉格齐：美国的信函是“积极一步”
items.body_zh: 伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格齐接受半岛电视台采访时表示，“我们目前已经形成了一项将实施期缩短至两天的方案”。他所指的显然是重开霍尔木兹海峡以及恢复与美国谈判的计划。 阿拉格齐称，美国副总统万斯的信函已在高层会议上得到研究和讨论。美国重启谈判的举措是“积极一步”。伊朗要求承认其与阿曼商定的霍尔木兹海峡新航线，并关闭其他航线。目前摆在桌面上的只有伊朗提出的霍尔木兹海峡重开方案。
items.title_en: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi: US letter is' positive step '
items.body_en: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said in an interview with Al Jazeera that "we have now formed a plan to shorten the implementation period to two days". He was clearly referring to plans to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume negotiations with the United States. Araghchi said the letter from U.S. Vice President Vance had been studied and discussed at a high-level meeting. The US move to restart negotiations is a “positive step”. Iran is demanding recognition of the new routes it has agreed with Oman in the Strait of Hormuz and the closure of other routes. Only Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is currently on the table.

items.body_en: China's official non-manufacturing PMI in October was 49.7, up from 50.2. China's official composite PMI in October was 49.7, up from 50.7.

editions.lead_en: Wall Street's momentum cracked: the S&P 500's winning streak ended, Google logged a record plunge and Intel crashed more than 20% after the bell on soft guidance, while ServiceNow had its worst day since its IPO. The ECB held rates but is reportedly ready to hike in December, and President Lagarde will step down in February, eight months early. Gold slipped back toward $4,200 an ounce as US PCE inflation ran at its hottest since May.
editions.lead_zh: 美股动能减弱：标普止步三连涨，谷歌创纪录暴跌，英特尔盘后重挫超20%，ServiceNow创上市以来最大单日跌幅。欧洲央行按兵不动，但据报已为12月加息做准备，拉加德宣布明年2月提前卸任。美国9月PCE同比涨3.6%创5月以来新高，现货黄金回落至4200美元附近。

items.title_zh: 华尔街见闻早餐 | 2026年10月30日
items.body_zh: 标普500指数止步三连涨，纳指跌1.4%，谷歌创纪录暴跌，云服务股普跌，盘后英特尔狂泻20%、亚马逊重挫。 欧洲央行按兵不动，行长拉加德宣布将于明年2月提前卸任，较原定任期提前8个月，继任程序当日启动。 美国9月PCE物价指数同比涨3.6%，创5月以来最高，核心PCE同比升至3.1%，个人储蓄率降至2022年10月以来最低。
items.title_en: Overnight wrap: S&P 500 winning streak ends as Google logs a record plunge
items.body_en: The S&P 500 snapped a three-day winning streak and the Nasdaq fell 1.4% as Google suffered a record drop and cloud-computing stocks sold off; Intel crashed more than 20% and Amazon slid after the bell. The ECB held rates, and President Christine Lagarde said she will step down in February, eight months ahead of schedule, with succession procedures starting immediately. US September PCE inflation ran 3.6% year on year, the hottest since May, with core PCE at 3.1% and the personal savings rate at its lowest since October 2022.

items.title_zh: 报道：欧洲央行做好了在12月加息的准备
items.body_zh: 据知情人士透露，欧洲央行官员做好了通胀前景不改善的情况下在12月份加息的准备。鉴于当前数据以及中东战争对经济造成的影响，可能还需要再加息25个基点，以遏制价格上涨。他们强调，目前尚未作出任何决定，形势可能迅速变化，尤其是由于中东局势的发展难以预测。 欧洲央行行长拉加德表示，本周曾讨论过加息，但她和同事最终决定将存款利率维持在2.5%不变。这一水平处于货币政策被认为对经济产生中性影响区间的上限。
items.title_en: Report: ECB ready to hike in December if inflation does not cool
items.body_en: ECB officials are prepared to raise rates in December unless the inflation outlook improves, people familiar with the matter said, adding that another 25bp may be needed to contain price pressures given current data and the economic impact of the Middle East war. They stressed no decision has been made and the situation could shift quickly. President Christine Lagarde said a hike was discussed this week before the bank held its deposit rate at 2.5%, the top of the range considered neutral for the economy.

items.title_zh: 亚洲芯片股下跌 围绕大型科技公司的AI融资担忧加剧
items.body_zh: 决定AI交易前景的关键财报季表现平平，导致全球芯片制造商股价下跌，投资者越来越担心成本飙升和需求的可持续性。 最新触发因素包括亚马逊的大规模资本支出数字...
items.title_en: Asian chip stocks fall as AI financing concerns mount
items.body_en: A lacklustre start to the key earnings season dragged global chipmakers lower as investors grew worried about soaring costs and the sustainability of demand, with Amazon's massive capital-spending figure among the latest triggers.

items.title_zh: 英特尔业绩向好，服务器芯片供不应求，四季度指引不及预期，股价盘后崩跌超20%
items.body_zh: 英特预计三季度数据中心与AI营收73.2亿美元，分析师预期66.7亿美元。 三季度代工（Intel Foundry）营收67亿美元，分析师预期61.2亿美元。 三季度调整后每股收益（EPS）为0.52美元，分析师预期0.41美元。 服务器芯片需求强劲，本公司无法满足，正设法改善供应问题。 服务器芯片供应受到以色列工厂火灾的冲击。 预计四季度营收150亿-160亿美元，分析师预期170.5亿美元。
items.title_en: Intel plunges over 20% after the bell as weak guidance offsets server-chip strength
items.body_en: Data center and AI revenue of $7.32 billion beat expectations of $6.67 billion, foundry revenue topped views at $6.7 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.52 beat the $0.41 consensus. But the company said it cannot meet surging server chip demand - supply has been hit by a fire at an Israeli plant - and guided fourth-quarter revenue to $15-16 billion, well short of the $17.05 billion analysts expected.

items.title_zh: “特斯拉劲敌”Rivian Automotive Inc.美股盘后涨5.33
items.body_zh: “特斯拉劲敌”Rivian Automotive Inc.美股盘后涨5.33%，该公司三季度业绩超过分析师预期，软件收入、新款入门级SSUV R2交付都有增长。 该公司三季度营收21.6亿美元，接受LSEG访问的分析师们预期19.9亿美元。 三季度调整后每股亏损0.48美元，分析师预期亏损0.62美元。 修订2026年业绩指引，来体现出符合预期的车辆交付改善、税前调整后盈利、资本开支。
items.title_en: Rivian jumps 5% after the bell as third-quarter results top estimates
items.body_en: Revenue was $2.16 billion against $1.99 billion expected, with an adjusted loss per share of $0.48 versus a $0.62 loss forecast, helped by growing software revenue and deliveries of the new entry-level R2 SUV. The company updated its 2026 guidance for vehicle deliveries, adjusted pre-tax profitability and capital spending.

items.title_zh: ServiceNOW收跌27%，创该公司美国IPO以来最大单日跌幅
items.body_zh: ServiceNOW收跌27%，创该公司美国IPO以来最大单日跌幅
items.title_en: ServiceNow sinks 27%, its worst day since its US IPO
items.body_en: ServiceNow closed down 27%, the biggest one-day drop since the company's US IPO.

items.title_zh: 欧洲股市收涨将近0.8%，欧元区蓝筹股阿迪达斯、拜耳、德银至少涨约3.8%
items.body_zh: 欧洲STOXX 600指数收涨0.77%，报649.11点。 欧元区STOXX 50指数收涨0.64%，报6207.07点，微幅低开后持续震荡上行，欧洲央行利率决议和行长拉加德讲话并未带来显著影响。 富时泛欧绩优300指数收涨0.77%，报2588.82点。
items.title_en: European stocks close up nearly 0.8% as Adidas, Bayer and Deutsche Bank rally
items.body_en: The STOXX 600 rose 0.77% to 649.11 and the eurozone STOXX 50 gained 0.64% to 6,207.07, grinding higher after a soft open, with the ECB decision and President Christine Lagarde's remarks drawing little reaction. The FTSEurofirst 300 added 0.77% to 2,588.82.

items.title_zh: 周四（10月29日）纽约尾盘，现货黄金跌1.13%，报4201.15美元/盎
items.body_zh: 周四（10月29日）纽约尾盘，现货黄金跌1.13%，报4201.15美元/盎司，整体持续走低，交投于4068.92-4005.47美元区间。 现货白银跌3.4%，报52.1440美元/盎司。 COMEX铜期货跌1.12%，报6.5965美元/磅。
items.title_en: Gold slides 1.13% to $4,201 an ounce in late New York trade
items.body_en: Spot gold fell 1.13% to $4,201.15 an ounce on Thursday, drifting lower through the session and trading between $4,068.92 and $4,005.47. Spot silver dropped 3.4% to $52.14 an ounce, and COMEX copper lost 1.12% to $6.5965 a pound.

items.title_zh: 德国两年期国债收益率于欧洲央行决议日跌超5个基点，可比法债收益率跌约8个基点
items.body_zh: 周四（10月29日）欧市尾盘，德国10年期国债收益率跌1.6个基点，报3.355%，日内交投于3.385%-3.317%区间，北京时间20:06微涨并刷新日高，随后呈现出W形走势，欧洲央行宣布按兵不动、美国GDP和PCE数据发布后，在欧洲央行行长拉加德新闻发布会期间刷新日低。
items.title_en: Bund yields slip after ECB decision; French yields fall about 8bp
items.body_en: Germany's two-year yield fell more than 5 basis points on Thursday, with comparable French yields down about 8bp. The 10-year Bund yield closed 1.6bp lower at 3.355% after trading between 3.385% and 3.317%, touching a session low during ECB President Christine Lagarde's press conference following the rate decision and the US GDP and PCE releases.

items.title_zh: 一线调研：储能角色重塑，锂电产业开启理性扩产周期
items.body_zh: 记者近日走访调研了宁德时代、欣旺达、杉杉股份等多家锂电产业链上下游龙头企业。记者在调研中了解到，从储能电池出货规模来看，储能行业正迈入TWh（太瓦时）新阶段，产业底层逻辑随之发生质变。储能从新能源配套设施升级为电力系统新型基础设施，行业评价重心从出厂参数转向电站全生命周期收益。
items.title_en: Energy storage steps into the TWh era as lithium battery makers turn to rational expansion
items.body_en: Field visits to industry leaders including CATL, Sunwoda and Shanshan found energy-storage shipments entering a new terawatt-hour-scale phase that is changing the industry's underlying logic: storage is being repositioned from a renewable-energy add-on to core power-system infrastructure, with the industry's yardstick shifting from factory specifications to whole-of-life returns at power stations.

items.title_zh: 江波龙发布前三季度业绩 归母净利润143.22亿元同比大增1909.68%
items.body_zh: 江波龙（09976）发布2026年前三季度业绩，该集团取得营业收入387.18亿元，同比增加131.37%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润143.22亿元，同比增加1909.68%；基本每股收益33...
items.title_en: Longsys nine-month profit soars more than nineteenfold on the memory upcycle
items.body_en: Longsys (09976.HK) reported nine-month revenue of 38.72 billion yuan, up 131.37% year on year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 14.32 billion yuan, up 1,909.68%. Basic earnings per share came in at 33 yuan.

items.title_zh: 广发证券前三季度归母净利润约160.27亿元 同比增长46.58%
items.body_zh: 广发证券（01776）公布2026年前三季度业绩，营业总收入约370.56亿元，同比增长41.63%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润约160.27亿元，同比增长46.58%；基本每股收益1.95元。
items.title_en: GF Securities H-shares: nine-month net profit up 46.58%
items.body_en: GF Securities (01776.HK) reported total operating revenue of 37.06 billion yuan for the first nine months, up 41.63% year on year, with net profit attributable to shareholders up 46.58% at 16.03 billion yuan. Basic earnings per share were 1.95 yuan.

items.title_zh: 淡水河谷三季度净利润12.6亿美元，分析师预期15.1亿美元
items.body_zh: 三季度铁矿石产量8835万吨，分析师预期9164万吨。 三季度铁矿石销售7551万吨，分析师预期7746万吨。 三季度净运营收入106亿美元，分析师预期104.1亿美元。 三季度调整后EBITDA（息税折旧摊薄前利润）为33.3亿美元。 三季度Pro Forma（形式上的/经调整的）EBITDA为35.1亿美元，分析师预期33.2亿美元。 三季度资本开支12.5亿美元。
items.title_en: Vale misses as third-quarter net profit comes in at $1.26 billion
items.body_en: Iron ore output was 88.35 million tonnes against expectations of 91.64 million, with sales of 75.51 million tonnes versus 77.46 million expected. Net operating revenue of $10.6 billion was slightly ahead of the $10.41 billion consensus. Adjusted EBITDA was $3.33 billion, or $3.51 billion pro forma versus $3.32 billion expected, and capital spending was $1.25 billion.

items.title_zh: 迦南智能
items.body_zh: 预中标国家电网2026年营销项目第二次设备公开招标采购项目及第二次设备（智能融合终端）公开招标采购项目，共7个标包，合计中标金额约1.51亿元，约占2025年度经审计主营业务收入的23.80%，目前处于中标候选人公示期。
items.title_en: Canaan Intelligence in line for State Grid awards worth about 151 million yuan
items.body_en: The company is a likely winner across seven lots in State Grid's second 2026 marketing-equipment and smart-convergence-terminal tenders, with a total award of about 151 million yuan, or about 23.8% of audited 2025 revenue. The result is in the candidate publicity period.

items.title_zh: 芯德半导体：启动H股全球发售，预计11月10日港交所上市
items.body_zh: 江苏芯德半导体科技股份有限公司公告称，公司启动H股全球发售，合计发售1.07亿股H股，其中香港公开发售1065.65万股、国际发售9590.60万股，发售价格区间为每股8.60港元至9.60港元，每手买卖单位500股，股份代号7672。香港公开发售采用全电子化申请程序，申请时间为2026年10月30日至11月5日，预计定价日为11月6日，H股预计11月10日在香港联交所开始买卖。
items.title_en: Xinde Semiconductor launches H-share offering, eyeing a November 10 listing
items.body_en: Jiangsu Xinde Semiconductor Technology is offering 107 million H shares - 10.66 million in the Hong Kong public offering and 95.91 million internationally - at HK$8.60-9.60 each, in board lots of 500 under stock code 7672. Applications run from October 30 to November 5, with pricing expected on November 6 and trading on the Hong Kong bourse from November 10.

items.title_zh: 贵州银行前三季度营业收入为93.61亿元 净利润33.47亿元
items.body_zh: 贵州银行（06199）公布2026年前三季度业绩，营业收入为93.61亿元，净利润33.47亿元。截至2026年9月末，该行资本充足率13.73%，一级资本充足率11.87%...
items.title_en: Bank of Guizhou books nine-month revenue of 9.36 billion yuan
items.body_en: Bank of Guizhou (06199.HK) posted nine-month revenue of 9.361 billion yuan and net profit of 3.347 billion yuan, with a capital adequacy ratio of 13.73% and a tier-1 capital adequacy ratio of 11.87% at the end of September.

items.title_zh: 国际原子能机构（IAEA）
items.body_zh: 已获悉，扎波罗热核电站（ZNPP）的一名员工在今天的无人机袭击中丧生。
items.title_en: IAEA says worker killed in drone strike on Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant
items.body_en: The UN nuclear watchdog said an employee of the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) was killed in today's drone attack.

editions.lead_en: The Federal Reserve held rates but two policymakers pushed for a hike, US equities extended their winning streak and the Bank of Canada delivered its first increase in more than three years. Earnings are doing the heavy lifting: Eli Lilly and Bristol-Myers Squibb both beat and raised, while BYD's third-quarter profit rose 28%. Gold held above $4,000 an ounce as investors wait on the ECB.
editions.lead_zh: 美联储按兵不动，但两名票委主张加息；美股三连涨，加拿大央行三年来首次加息。财报季成为主线：礼来、百时美施贵宝双双超预期并上调指引，比亚迪三季度净利增长28%。金价站稳4000美元上方，市场等待欧央行决议。

items.title_zh: 华尔街见闻早餐 | 2026年10月29日
items.body_zh: 美联储维持联邦基金利率目标区间在3.75%至4.00%不变，库克与哈马克两名票委主张加息25个基点；美股指三连涨，甲骨文大涨11%，盘后绩后谷歌大跌10%；WTI原油12月合约涨2.88%。 加拿大央行加息25个基点至2.5%，为三年多来首次，称需降低高能源价格向其他商品和服务扩散的风险，并提示可能还需进一步加息。
items.title_en: Fed holds rates as two dissenters push for a hike; US stocks extend winning streak
items.body_en: The Federal Reserve kept its target range at 3.75%-4.00%, with policymakers Cook and Hammack dissenting in favour of a 25bp increase. US equities rose for a third straight session, Oracle jumped 11% and Alphabet fell 10% after the bell on its results. WTI December crude added 2.88%. The Bank of Canada raised rates 25bp to 2.5%, its first hike in more than three years, warning that high energy prices risk spilling into other goods and services.

items.title_zh: 欧洲央行行长拉加德将提前卸任 继任之争将升温
items.body_zh: 欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德宣布她将于2027年初卸任，接替这位全球最具权势的货币政策制定者之一的竞争将由此升温。
items.title_en: Lagarde to step down early, opening the race for ECB succession
items.body_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde has said she will leave in early 2027, setting off a contest to replace one of the world's most powerful monetary policymakers.

items.title_zh: 美联储决议后美欧国债收益率下跌，市场聚焦欧洲央行会议
items.body_zh: 市场预计欧洲央行将于周四跟随美联储，维持利率不变。 周四欧洲早盘，在市场消化美联储利率决议之际，美国国债和欧洲各国政府债券收益率普遍下跌...
items.title_en: Treasury and eurozone bond yields slide after Fed decision; ECB in focus
items.body_en: Markets expect the ECB to hold rates steady on Thursday, following the Fed's pause. US Treasury and European government bond yields fell broadly in European morning trade as investors worked through the Fed's decision.

items.title_zh: 周三（10月28日）纽约尾盘，现货黄金涨0.17%，报4066.85美元/盎
items.body_zh: 周三（10月28日）纽约尾盘，现货黄金涨0.17%，报4066.85美元/盎司，日内交投于4025.21-4082.58美元，经历了美联储按兵不动、主席沃什新闻发布会之后，在美股收盘时刷新日高。 现货白银跌0.81%，报53.857美元/盎司，美股收盘时刷新日高。 COMEX铜期货涨0.45%，报6.6825美元/磅。
items.title_en: Gold edges up to $4,066.85 an ounce in late New York trade
items.body_en: Spot gold rose 0.17% to $4,066.85 an ounce on Wednesday, trading between $4,025.21 and $4,082.58 before printing a session high at the US close, after the Fed stood pat and Chair Kevin Warsh met the press. Spot silver slipped 0.81% to $53.857 an ounce, while COMEX copper gained 0.45% to $6.6825 a pound.

items.title_zh: 礼来第三季度营收为244.0亿美元，预期为225.2亿美元
items.body_zh: 第三季度调整后每股收益为7.48美元，预期为5.59美元。 礼来预计全年调整后每股收益为35.00至36.00美元，此前预期为35.50至36.50美元。 礼来预计全年营收为910亿至920亿美元，此前预期为850亿至870亿美元。 礼来美股盘前涨超5%。
items.title_en: Eli Lilly lifts guidance after third-quarter revenue tops estimates
items.body_en: Revenue came in at $24.40 billion against expectations of $22.52 billion, with adjusted EPS of $7.48 versus $5.59 forecast. Lilly now sees full-year revenue of $91-92 billion, up from $85-87 billion, and adjusted EPS of $35.00-36.00. The shares rose more than 5% in premarket trading.

items.title_zh: 百时美施贵宝第三季度营收为130.7亿美元，预期为127.1亿美元
items.body_zh: 第三季度调整后每股收益为1.35美元，预期为1.12美元。 百时美施贵宝预计全年营收约为497.5亿至502.5亿美元，此前预期约为490亿至500亿美元。
items.title_en: Bristol-Myers Squibb beats on third-quarter revenue of $13.07 billion
items.body_en: Adjusted earnings per share were $1.35 against $1.12 expected. The drugmaker guided full-year revenue to roughly $49.75-50.25 billion, up from a prior range of $49-50 billion.

items.title_zh: 荷兰国际集团宣布全球裁员约400人，预计每年削减成本7500万欧元
items.body_zh: 10月29日，荷兰国际集团（ING）公布，计划重组批发银行业务，预计全球裁员约400人，相关调整将于2027年3月1日起生效。公司预计相关措施将产生约1.75亿欧元税前裁员费用，并每年削减成本约7500万欧元，自2028年起全面生效。该行第三季度净利润为18.5亿欧元，同比增长3.5%；税前利润增长5.7%至27.05亿欧元。
items.title_en: ING to cut about 400 jobs worldwide in wholesale banking overhaul
items.body_en: ING Group will restructure its wholesale banking business, shedding roughly 400 roles globally with the changes effective from 1 March 2027. The lender expects about 175 million euros of pre-tax restructuring charges and annual cost savings of some 75 million euros from 2028. Third-quarter net profit rose 3.5% year on year to 1.85 billion euros, with pre-tax profit up 5.7% at 2.705 billion euros.

items.title_zh: 比亚迪第三季度净利润同比增长28.1% 前三季度净利润下降4.2%
items.body_zh: 比亚迪发布2026年第三季度报告，第三季度实现营业收入2214.88亿元，同比增长13.59%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润100.20亿元，同比增长28.08%。前三季度实现营业收入5663.04亿元，同比增长0.01%；归母净利润223.45亿元，同比下降4.24%；扣非归母净利润210.04亿元，同比增长2.51%。前三季度经营活动产生的现金流量净额544.70亿元，同比增长33.36%。
items.title_en: BYD third-quarter net profit rises 28.1% even as nine-month profit slips 4.2%
items.body_en: Third-quarter revenue grew 13.59% year on year to 221.49 billion yuan, with net profit attributable to shareholders up 28.08% at 10.02 billion yuan. Nine-month revenue was 566.30 billion yuan, up 0.01%, while net profit fell 4.24% to 22.35 billion yuan. Operating cash flow rose 33.36% to 54.47 billion yuan.

items.title_zh: 兆易创新净利增逾9倍！私募大佬重仓未动
items.body_zh: 存储龙头兆易创新披露2026年三季报，公司前三季度实现营业收入202.97亿元，同比增长197.11%；归母净利润110.66亿元，同比增长921.55%。三季报显示，葛卫东持股1644.67万股，与半年报相同，仍为公司第四大股东。（证券时报）
items.title_en: GigaDevice profit up more than ninefold as the memory upcycle bites
items.body_en: The memory chipmaker reported nine-month revenue of 20.30 billion yuan, up 197.11% year on year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 11.07 billion yuan, up 921.55%. Private-fund investor Ge Weidong held 16.45 million shares at the end of September, unchanged from the half-year report, remaining the fourth-largest shareholder. (Securities Times)

items.title_zh: 广发证券：前三季度归母净利润160.27亿元，同比增长46.58%
items.body_zh: 广发证券公告，2026年前三季度营业总收入370.56亿元，同比增长41.63%；归母净利润160.27亿元，同比增长46.58%；扣非净利润161.01亿元，同比增长50.32%。第三季度单季营业总收入101.73亿元，同比下降5.51%；归母净利润43.76亿元，同比下降1.99%；扣非净利润41.96亿元，同比下降4.63%。
items.title_en: GF Securities nine-month net profit up 46.58%
items.body_en: Total operating revenue rose 41.63% year on year to 37.06 billion yuan in the first nine months, with net profit attributable to shareholders up 46.58% at 16.03 billion yuan. Third-quarter revenue fell 5.51% to 10.17 billion yuan and net profit slipped 1.99% to 4.38 billion yuan.

items.title_zh: 白银有色：前三季度归母净利润7.17亿元，同比扭亏
items.body_zh: 白银有色公告，2026年前三季度营业收入771.83亿元，同比增长6.25%；归母净利润7.17亿元，上年同期为-2.15亿元，同比扭亏；扣非净利润6.8亿元，同比扭亏。第三季度单季营业收入314亿元，同比增长11.80%；归母净利润6.37亿元，同比增长28318.04%；扣非净利润6.23亿元，同比增长6613.64%。
items.title_en: Baiyin Nonferrous swings to profit as metals prices lift margins
items.body_en: Nine-month revenue rose 6.25% to 77.18 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders reached 717 million yuan, reversing a 215 million yuan loss a year earlier. Third-quarter net profit jumped to 637 million yuan, up 28,318% year on year, on revenue of 31.4 billion yuan.

items.title_zh: 上纬新材：2026年第三季度净利润亏损2.55亿元
items.body_zh: 上纬新材公告，2026年第三季度营业收入4.06亿元，同比下降18.04%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润亏损2.55亿元，上年同期为盈利3067.58万元；扣非净利润亏损2.56亿元。前三季度营业收入12.09亿元，同比下降5.51%；归母净利润亏损4.22亿元，上年同期为盈利6055.32万元；扣非净利润亏损4.25亿元。消费级具身智能机器人业务研发、营销及供应链投入增加，报告期内该业务尚未确认收入。
items.title_en: Swancor Advanced Materials posts a 255 million yuan third-quarter loss
items.body_en: Revenue fell 18.04% year on year to 406 million yuan in the quarter, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of 255 million yuan versus a 30.7 million yuan profit a year earlier. Nine-month revenue was 1.209 billion yuan, down 5.51%, and the net loss reached 422 million yuan. Spending on R&D, marketing and supply chain for its consumer robotics business rose, with no revenue yet recognised.

items.title_zh: 兴业银行
items.body_zh: 第三季度净利润195.6亿元，同比下降1.92%；前三季度净利润606.9亿元，同比下降3.79%。
items.title_en: Industrial Bank third-quarter net profit down 1.92%
items.body_en: Third-quarter net profit was 19.56 billion yuan, down 1.92% year on year; nine-month net profit fell 3.79% to 60.69 billion yuan.

items.title_zh: 比亚迪电子
items.body_zh: 2026年前三季营收1274.58亿元，同比增长3.38%。
items.title_en: BYD Electronic nine-month revenue up 3.38%
items.body_en: Revenue for the first nine months of 2026 reached 127.46 billion yuan, up 3.38% from a year earlier.

items.title_zh: 新联电子
items.body_zh: 公司为国家电网有限公司2026年营销项目第二次设备公开招标采购及智能融合终端公开招标采购的中标候选人，共中智能融合终端包10、专变采集终端包11和包32共3个包，预计中标总金额约5558.5万元，占2025年营业收入的8.08%。
items.title_en: Xinlian Electronics in line for State Grid tender worth about 55.6 million yuan
items.body_en: The company is a candidate to win State Grid's second 2026 equipment tender and its smart terminal tender, taking three packages. The total award is estimated at 55.59 million yuan, equal to 8.08% of 2025 revenue.

items.title_zh: 超图软件
items.body_zh: 截至2026年10月28日，公司回购方案实施完毕，累计回购508.02万股，占总股本1.03%，成交总金额5999.12万元（不含交易费用），成交价10.10元/股至12.42元/股，回购股份用于员工持股计划及/或股权激励。
items.title_en: SuperMap completes buyback of 1.03% of its share capital
items.body_en: The company finished its buyback programme on 28 October, repurchasing 5.0802 million shares, or 1.03% of total share capital, for 59.99 million yuan at prices of 10.10 to 12.42 yuan. The shares will fund an employee stock ownership plan and equity incentives.

items.title_zh: 微芯生物
items.body_zh: 董事长XIANPING LU博士提议公司以集中竞价交易方式回购股份，资金总额不低于3000万元、不超过5000万元，回购股份用于员工持股计划或股权激励。
items.title_en: Chipscreen chairman proposes a 30-50 million yuan buyback
items.body_en: Chairman Dr. Xianping Lu proposed repurchasing shares through centralised bidding for between 30 million and 50 million yuan, to be used for an employee stock ownership plan or equity incentives.
